Baiju is a researcher for the [[Huaxu Academy]]. He can be found talking to [[Qinru]] during 07:00 to 18:00 and alone between 18:00 to 06:00.

==Location==
(-270,1319,7)

==Quests and Events==
{{Quests and Events|Baiju}}

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Day)
:'''Baiju:'''  A quantitative change leading to a qualitative change is not just about the quantity. Have you factored in the weight?
:'''Baiju:'''  The weight distribution of the weapon will affect the accuracy, speed, and even the effective range of the attack.
:'''Baiju:'''  The current designs have an even weight distribution compatible with most wielder's habits, which was approximated by the Ordance Division through rounds of trials and modeling.
:'''Baiju:'''  Instead of strategizing on paper out of pure imagination.
:'''Baiju:'''  It's normal for ordinary people to be curious about the unknown Tacetite weapon, but if you're  serious about studying it—
:'''Baiju:'''  –you should master the basics of Tacetite before you get ahead of yourself.
:'''Baiju:'''  Like this, asking me every day, the work in my hands is almost too busy.

;(Night)
:'''Baiju:''' Ah, peace at last. Finally, I can have some time for me to think about the iteration of the [[Tacetite]] weapons.
:'''Baiju:''' The most important in research is to block out frequent external disruptions. As a rookie researcher, I had the opportunity to collaborate with [[Mortefi]] before.
:'''Baiju:''' He said that the research process is like playing a musical piece, the melody should be coherent and uninterrupted by any distractions from the audience.
:'''Baiju:''' Though the grand tower of Tacetite studies is almost established, there are still two clouds obscuring the sky above it.
:'''Baiju:''' Not far away, you can vaguely see a few small dark clouds drifting. What we have to do is to clear the clouds and let the sun shines through.
:'''Baiju:''' After hearing this, it's like I was awakened from a daze and suddenly I found a path forward.
:'''Baiju:''' Isn't it the reason why I set foot on this path to see the views behind those dark clouds? At the very least, I need to try to keep up.
:'''Baiju:''' So that I can reach the highest point of the Tacetite building with everyone.
{{Dialogue End}}
